San Paolo (Borgo San Paolo / Cit Turin) — Turin, Italy

Tranquillo giorno Attenzione media notte

In dettaglio

Former working-class district (covers what locals also call Borgo San Paolo and Cit Turin) undergoing regeneration. Generally calm by day, with a few streets worth more caution at night.
